title: Seal and attach the crankcase halves
imprint: WSM Group 1 Part 1, pages 10-51 to 10-56, supplement 38, 1999

notices.text: Procedure 10 10 37, WSM Group 1 Part 1, pages 10-51 to 10-56 (supplement 38, 1999), and torque table page 1-1. This edition is for the M96/01. The Service Information MY2002 says that the four-part crankcase design is unchanged on the M96/03 (Group 0, page 200). The torque book (page 15) confirms the 25 M6 × 35 bolts at 13 Nm and the three 22 Nm screws for M96.0X.
Install all the bolts in less than five minutes after you apply the silicone bead. Start the timer when you start the bead. Cured sealant does not seal.

Use only Drei Bond silicone type 1209 or Loctite 5900 to seal the crankcase halves. Apply a bead of approximately 1.5 mm width to the clean sealing surface of the bank 4-6 half. Too much sealant goes into the oil system.
The three bearing-housing screws through the crankcase (9 × 150, M9 × 94, 9 × 94) get their 22 Nm torque only after the cylinder heads are attached. They get new O-rings 12 × 2.

steps.text: Clean the two sealing surfaces fully. Old Loctite 5900 is black. Make sure that the 4 dowel sleeves (17 M6 × 18.5) and the 3 cylindrical pins (12 × 22) are installed. Replace the 2 gaskets. (10-52, 10-53)
Put the 25 micro-encapsulated hexagon-head bolts M6 × 35 on the bolt map, each at its position. Do not use bolts that are not micro-encapsulated. (10-52, no. 8, and 10-55, no. 4)
Cut the first metering step of the nozzle at an angle. Start the timer. Apply a uniform bead of approximately 1.5 mm width to the bank 4-6 half. (10-55, no. 1 and 2)
Carefully put the crankcase half in position. Do not damage the bead. (10-55, no. 3)
Tighten the bolts to 13 Nm in the sequence of Fig. 443_96. Use the guided mode. (10-55, no. 4, and 10-56)
Install the bearing-housing screws with new O-rings. Tighten them by hand only. The 22 Nm torque comes after the cylinder heads are attached. (10-52, no. 1 to 5)
Install the screw plug M27 × 2 for the piston-pin assembly bore with a new sealing ring A27 × 32. Tighten to 80 Nm. (10-52, no. 6 and 7)
